overview: Fiber Network Fault Localization addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in telecommunications operations. The first proof of value uses OTDR traces, GIS routes and trouble tickets. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is mean time to identify fiber break, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: mean time to identify fiber break

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: OTDR traces, GIS routes and trouble tickets; define mean time to identify fiber break and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Network Operations Director / Telco Product VP.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
